summary: Retest of iteration_1 call-signalling fixes using two pages in a chromium launched with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream/--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream (375x667). ALL PASSED: (1) viewer Rifiuta while ringing -> sender 'Chiamata rifiutata dal visore.', sender-call-button visible, hangup hidden; viewer 'Chiamata rifiutata. In attesa di chiamata.' (also works when declining immediately after incoming appears). (2) sender Annulla chiamata while ringing -> viewer-incoming disappears, viewer 'Chiamata annullata da chi chiamava. In attesa di chiamata.'; closing the sender tab while ringing also clears viewer incoming. (3) Answer flow: sender-live-badge + viewer-hangup-button, statuses 'Collegato...' on both, fake green video rendered; hangup from viewer and from sender -> both idle; viewer stage black with 'In attesa del video…' (iframe hint visible, no stale frame - screenshot verified). (4) Ring timeout: sender returned to idle after exactly 45.0s with 'Nessuna risposta dal visore.', viewer incoming cleared with 'Chiamata annullata...'. (5) Chips now 44px high (viewer-view-drag-chip, viewer-format-sbs-chip); Rispondi stays within 16px margin (x 16.4-19.7) and equals Rifiuta width at rest (~165px, pulses down to 0.95 scale). No deprecated Expo packages / SafeAreaView issues observed in reviewed files.
critical_code_review_comments: stage.html handlers.decline only notifies sender if the PeerJS DataConnection is already open (dc.open); on slow networks a very fast decline could fall back to the 45s ring timeout. Optional: queue the decline until dc 'open' or also close via call.
Callers that don't open a DataConnection (e.g. the external Meta Quest page mentioned on home) won't receive decline; they rely on their own timeout.
viewer peer 'connection' handler accepts any incoming DataConnection without limit; harmless but could be keyed only to the pending call's peer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-peer test approach: in browser_automation, bt = page.context.browser.browser_type; launch a new browser with fake media args, new_context with camera/microphone permissions, open /viewer and /sender, read 6-digit code from viewer-code, wait for sender-status 'Camera pronta', fill sender-code-input, tap sender-call-button, wait viewer-incoming. Stage hint lives in the iframe (#hint).
